name: smwmusic-the-sword-of-lxsor-bgm-b7-final-offensive
title: The Sword of Lxsor - BGM B7 ("Final Offensive")
description:
The Sword of Lxsor is an unreleased game for the Sharp X68000, and this is one of its many tracks. There's no known official name for it. Jharmonious, who compiled the soundtrack of the game, gave the track a title.

Good for tense areas.
